name: Parallel DVR Algorithm (Object-Space Decomposition)
aliases: Parallel DVR Algorithm (Object-Space Decomposition) — OS-DVR, View-Dependent Remapping DVR
definition: A parallel direct volume rendering algorithm consisting of four phases: clustering, remapping, local rendering, and pixel merging. Clustering is view-independent; remapping is view-dependent.
summary: OS-DVR is a parallel direct volume rendering method that minimizes communication by dynamically remapping volumetric clusters based on viewing parameters.
